description: Arm automatic handling of the next JavaScript alert/confirm/prompt on the active tab, then return immediately. Call this BEFORE the click that opens the dialog - a dialog freezes the tab, so nothing can be clicked once it is on screen. Pass wait=true only when the dialog is already opening.

action.description: Accept or dismiss the dialog (default: accept)

text.description: Text to enter for prompt() dialogs

timeout.description: How long the arming stays active in ms (default: 60000)

wait.description: Block until a dialog appears instead of arming and returning (default: false). Only use when the dialog is already on its way.

name: browser_handle_dialog
